positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
• Develop proprietary, fully-customized system featuring:
   • In-house CRM, utilized by sales director, customer care department, natural gas trading floor, and accounting.
   • User-friendly custom reporting functionality.
   • Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), utility, and customer billing ability.
• Directly liaise with utilities in three states to identify EDI, customer data, and billing information inaccuracies.
• Mentor and train new employees in database structure, SQL, customer billing, and channel partner data.
• Migrate company database from Access to mySQL to ensure scalability.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
• Created and maintained a Manifest system in Microsoft Access/VBA, used locally and by principals overseas.  Functionalities include generating and managing Bills of Ladings (provided to US Customs) and EDI communication with Port Authorities.
• Designed Accounts Payable System in PHP/MSQL.
• Created company website and custom .Net utility to update website shipping schedules.
• Administered local Windows Server (Active Directory) and Microsoft Workstations, including support for offsite offices/employees.
• Assisted company in becoming ISO 9002 certified.
• Survived Y2K
